quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on his high school dynamic with Melton
quotes.excerpt: He wasn't scoring in high school. He was more defense, straight defense. I was offensive player

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Coach spoke about how you and Melton both had great games back court in high school. He said you guys probably gave a lot of trouble to opposing teams back then. Do you have a couple memories like highest scores of you guys as a duo in high school?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Williams
text_blocks.text: Nah, he wasn't scoring in high school. He was more defense, straight defense. I was offensive player, so we kind of met each other very well. He took care of that end, I took care of offense. Tonight was his offensive night, but back then it was fun.

quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on his high school dynamic with Melton: He was straight defense and I was the offensive player. We met each other very well.

structured.context: Brandon Williams reflects on his high school basketball dynamic with teammate De'Anthony Melton.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on his role in the Warriors' bench unit
quotes.excerpt: That's my job. That's what they brought me in to do, to keep that offense running
quotes.quote: That's my job. That's what they brought me in to do, to keep that offense running when the starting point guard comes out, so our offense doesn't look stagnant. I know my job, I know my role, and I'm going to do that as much as I can.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on his role with the Warriors: My job is to keep the offense running when the starting point guard comes out so we do not look stagnant.

structured.context: Brandon Williams explains his responsibilities as a bench player for the Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on the Road Runner sound effect after scoring
quotes.excerpt: I want like an engine going or something like that. That would be more lit
quotes.quote: No, I want like an engine going or something like that. That would be more lit, but I'm not mad at the meep-meep. I think George kind of started that preseason and stuff, but I'm not mad at it. I'd rather have a Ferrari or some engine going crazy, but I'll take the meep-meep.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams is not a fan of the Road Runner meep-meep sound effect after he scores: I want an engine going or something like that. I would rather have a Ferrari or some engine going crazy.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on staying ready while watching the team struggle
quotes.excerpt: I know exactly what I need to fill in and what the team needed more than anything
quotes.quote: I think I said it the other day, I know exactly what I need to fill in and what the team needed more than anything, especially with Steph going down. They brought me in for a reason. I know my role, I know exactly what I need to do, and I'm glad I got out there and showed it in 12 minutes and 44 seconds.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on stepping up while Steph Curry is out: They brought me in for a reason. I know my role, I know exactly what I need to do, and I am glad I got out there and showed it.

structured.context: Brandon Williams discusses staying prepared to contribute to the team following Stephen Curry's injury.
